1754-the-sea-gull.title: The Sea Gull
1754-the-sea-gull.creator: Anton Checkov
1754-the-sea-gull.description: A book by Anton Checkov. sisters, my little brother and I must all live somehow on my salary of twenty-three roubles a month. We have to eat and drink, I take it. You wouldn’t have us go without tea and sugar, would you? Answer me that, if you can.

61984-sylvia-a-novel.title: Sylvia A Novel
61984-sylvia-a-novel.creator: Unknown
61984-sylvia-a-novel.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. or did I ever know what it was to be bored by them. The incident might be commonplace—a bit of a flirtation, the ordering of a costume, the blunder of a negro servant; but it was always Sylvia who was telling it—there was always the sparkle of her eyes, the mischievous smile, the swift glow of her countenance.

arxiv-1705-03374.title: Measurement of b b -hadron pair production with the ATLAS detector in proton-proton collisions at s = 8 \sqrt{s}=8 TeV
arxiv-1705-03374.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1705-03374.description: Abstract A measurement of b b -hadron pair production is presented, based on a data set corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 11.4 fb -1 of proton–proton collisions recorded at s = 8 \sqrt{s}=8 TeV with the ATLAS detector at the LHC.

arxiv-2102-07406.title: Stable Systems with Power Law Conditions for Poisson Hail
arxiv-2102-07406.creator: Thomas Mountford, Zhe Wang
arxiv-2102-07406.description: Abstract We consider Poisson hail models and characterize up to boundaries the collection of critical moments which guarantee stability. In particular, we treat the case of infinite speed of propagation. 1 Introduction 1.1 Model and dynamics In this article we treat the Poisson hail model introduced in [ BF11 ] .

arxiv-2202-04376.title: Improving short-term bike sharing demand forecast through an irregular convolutional neural network
arxiv-2202-04376.creator: Xinyu Li, Yang Xu, Xiaohu Zhang, Wenzhong Shi, Yang Yue, Qingquan Li
arxiv-2202-04376.description: Abstract As an important task for the management of bike sharing systems, accurate forecast of travel demand could facilitate dispatch and relocation of bicycles to improve user satisfaction. In recent years, many deep learning algorithms have been introduced to improve bicycle usage forecast.

arxiv-2203-00878.title: The First Insight- HXMT Gamma-Ray Burst Catalog: The First Four Years
arxiv-2203-00878.creator: Xin-Ying Song, Shao-Lin Xiong, Shuang-Nan Zhang, Cheng-Kui Li, Xiao-Bo Li, Yue Huang, Cristiano Guidorzi, Filippo Frontera, Cong-Zhan Liu, Xu-Fang Li, Gang Li, Jin-Yuan Liao, Ce Cai, Qi Luo, Shuo Xiao, Qi-Bin Yi, Yao-Guang Zheng, Deng-Ke Zhou, Jia-Cong Liu, Wang-Chen Xue, Yan-Qiu Zhang, Chao Zheng,
arxiv-2203-00878.description: Abstract The Hard X-ray Modulation Telescope ( Insight- HXMT), is China’s first X-ray astronomy satellite launched on June 15, 2017. The anti-coincidence CsI detectors of the High Energy X-ray telescope (HE) onboard Insight- HXMT could serve as an all-sky gamma-ray monitor in about 0.2-3 MeV.

arxiv-2204-03663.title: High energy particles from young supernovae: gamma-ray and neutrino connections
arxiv-2204-03663.creator: and Katie Auchettl
arxiv-2204-03663.description: Abstract Young core-collapse supernovae (YSNe) are factories of high-energy neutrinos and gamma-rays as the shock accelerated protons efficiently interact with the protons in the dense circumstellar medium. We explore the detection prospects of secondary particles from YSNe of Type IIn, II-P, IIb/II-L, and Ib/c.

arxiv-2312-09760.title: U2-KWS: Unified Two-pass Open-vocabulary Keyword Spotting with Keyword Bias
arxiv-2312-09760.creator: Ao Zhang 1 , Pan Zhou 2 , Kaixun Huang 1 , Yong Zou 2 ,Ming Liu 2 , Lei Xie 1∗
arxiv-2312-09760.description: Abstract Open-vocabulary keyword spotting (KWS), which allows users to customize keywords, has attracted increasingly more interest. However, existing methods based on acoustic models and post-processing train the acoustic model with ASR training criteria to model all phonemes, making the acoustic model under-optimized for the KWS task.

arxiv-2503-16795.creator: Yihan Hu 1,2,4∗, Jianing Peng 1,4, Yiheng Lin 1,2,4, Ting Liu 2, Xiaochao Qu 2, Luoqi Liu 2, Yao Zhao 1,3,4, Yunchao Wei 1,3,4† 1 Institute of Information Science, Beijing Jiaotong University 2 MT Lab, Meitu Inc 3 Pengcheng Laboratory, Shenzhen, China 4 Visual Intelligence + X International Joint La
arxiv-2503-16795.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yihan Hu 1,2,4∗, Jianing Peng 1,4, Yiheng Lin 1,2,4, Ting Liu 2, Xiaochao Qu 2, Luoqi Liu 2, Yao Zhao 1,3,4, Yunchao Wei 1,3,4† 1 Institute of Information Science, Beijing Jiaotong University 2 MT Lab, Meitu Inc 3 Pengcheng Laboratory, Shenzhen, China 4 Visual Intelligence + X International Joint La. This paper presents a novel approach to improving text-guided image editing using diffusion-based models.

arxiv-2505-01520.title: Content and Quality Analysis of Parent-Facing Applications for Feeding Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder
arxiv-2505-01520.creator: 1 st Christopher Cofie Kuzagbe, 2 nd Fabrice Mukarage, 3 rd Skye Nandi Adams, 4 th N’guessan Yves-Roland Douha, 5 th Edith Talina Luhanga
arxiv-2505-01520.description: Abstract Approximately 1 in 100 children worldwide are diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), and 46% to 89% experience significant feeding difficulties. Although mobile health (mHealth) applications offer potential support for caregivers, the quality and relevance of apps targeting autism-related feeding issues remain unclear.

britannica-1911-pinar-del-rio.description: Article 'Pinar del Rio' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. by railway from Havana. The city is in the fertile valley of the Guama. It is the centre of the tobacco industry of the Vuelta Abajo region. Its port is La Coloma, on the southern coast. The pueblo was created after 1773; but the history of the settlement goes back to 1571, and the parochial church dates from 1710.

pmc-10656773.title: Factors influencing withdrawal of life-supporting treatment in cervical spinal cord injury: a large multicenter observational cohort study
pmc-10656773.creator: Husain Shakil, Armaan K Malhotra, Rachael H Jaffe, Christopher W Smith, Erin M Harrington, Alick P Wang, Eva Y Yuan, Yingshi He, Karim Ladha, Duminda N Wijeysundera, Avery B Nathens, Jefferson R Wilson, Christopher D Witiw
pmc-10656773.description: BackgroundTraumatic spinal cord injury (SCI) leads to profound neurologic sequelae, and the provision of life-supporting treatment serves great importance among this patient population. The decision for withdrawal of life-supporting treatment (WLST) in complete traumatic SCI is complex with the lack of guidelines and limited understanding of practice patterns.

pmc-10671305.title: Regulation of Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transitions by Alternative Splicing: Potential New Area for Cancer Therapeutics
pmc-10671305.creator: Ling Li, Jinxia Zheng, Sebastian Oltean
pmc-10671305.description: The epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) is a complicated biological process in which cells with epithelial phenotype are transformed into mesenchymal cells with loss of cell polarity and cell–cell adhesion and gain of the ability to migrate. EMT and the reverse mesenchymal-epithelial transitions (METs) are present during cancer progression and metastasis.

pmc-10742102.title: Navigating Challenges and Advances in Pediatric Psoriasis and Atopic Dermatitis Treatment
pmc-10742102.creator: Katie K Lovell, Lindsay C Strowd, Steven R Feldman
pmc-10742102.description: er of treatments available for adults. On the other hand, AD is one of the most prevalent systemic inflammatory diseases in childhood, with a multitude of therapeutics in the pipeline [2]. As discussed in Chovatiya and Silverberg’s review of the pathophysiology of both diseases, the enhanced insight into the disease mechanisms has led to a “therapeutic revolution”.

pmc-11608494.title: A transient blood IL-17 increase triggers neuroinflammation in cerebellum and motor incoordination in hyperammonemic rats
pmc-11608494.creator: Yaiza M Arenas, Carmina Montoliu, Marta Llansola, Vicente Felipo
pmc-11608494.description: Patients with liver cirrhosis may show minimal hepatic encephalopathy (MHE) with motor incoordination which is reproduced in hyperammonemic rats. Hyperammonemia induces peripheral inflammation which triggers neuroinflammation and enhanced GABAergic neurotransmission in cerebellum and motor incoordination. The mechanisms involved remain unknown.

pmc-11658837.title: Clinical Utility of Bone Turnover Markers in Chronic Kidney Disease
pmc-11658837.creator: Praopilad Srisuwarn, Richard Eastell, Syazrah Salam
pmc-11658837.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) often leads to mineral and bone disorders (CKD-MBDs), which are nearly universal in patients undergoing dialysis. CKD-MBD includes abnormal calcium-phosphate metabolism, vascular and soft tissue calcification, and bone abnormalities (renal osteodystrophy [ROD]). Bone fragility in CKD occurs due to low bone mass and poor bone quality, and patients with CKD have higher fracture and mortality rates.

pmc-12506955.title: Cardiac Autonomic Dysfunction in Obstructive Sleep Apnea: The Hidden Role of Vitamin D Deficiency
pmc-12506955.creator: Huai Heng Loh, Siow Phing Tay, Ai Jiun Koa, Mei Ching Yong, Asri Said, Chee Shee Chai, Natasya Marliana Abdul Malik, Anselm Ting Su, Bonnie Bao Chee Tang, Florence Hui Sieng Tan, Norlela Sukor
pmc-12506955.description: and aging population [1]. While men are still more likely to be diagnosed with OSA, this condition is becoming more common in women [2]. Coronary artery disease (CAD), a common complication of OSA, is driven by a combination of intermittent hypoxia, metabolic dysfunction, and systemic inflammation, which together accelerate atherosclerosis [3].

pmc-12969862.title: Based on the gut–heart axis: Polygonum capitatum improves atherosclerosis by modulating gut microbiota and TMAO, supporting MCPIP1/p53-associated endothelial protection
pmc-12969862.creator: Yunpei Wang, Weiyi Tian, Zi Ye, Yuanzhu Liao, Chunhua Huang, Dake Qi, Yuhui Wang, Yajie Chen, Yixia Zhou
pmc-12969862.description: Polygonum capitatum (PC), known as “Tou Hua Liao” (Chinese name), is an essential source of Hmong medicinal plants, which has been used for treating various human diseases. This study examined whether PC has lipid-lowering and anti-atherosclerotic effects and explored the underlying mechanisms. We focused on PC’s influence on gut microbiota–derived metabolites.

pmc-13131691.title: Single‐Molecule Forster Resonance Energy Transfer With a Minimalistic 3D‐Printed Setup and Dyes in the Blue‐Green Spectral Region
pmc-13131691.creator: Gabriel G Moya Muñoz, Jorge R Luna Piedra, Pazit Con, Mostofa Ataur Rohman, Siyu Lu, Thomas‐Otavio Peulen, Thorben Cordes
pmc-13131691.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Förster Resonance Energy Transfer (FRET) is a powerful technique for the detection and characterization of biomolecular interactions and conformational changes with subnanometer spatial resolution and a temporal resolution down to the timescale of fluorescence. While the technique is widely adopted in structural biology and biophysics, the evolution of single‐molecule FRET has led to experimental setups with sophisticated optical layouts, multilaser excitation schemes, and time‐resolved detection electronics.

pmc-13229848.title: Intravascular papillary endothelial hyperplasia within the uterine myometrium: a case report and literature review
pmc-13229848.creator: Li-li Wei, Li-xing Zhang, Xiang-lan Mo
pmc-13229848.description: Intravascular papillary endothelial hyperplasia (IPEH) is a rare vascular lesion that can histologically mimic malignant vascular tumors, particularly angiosarcoma, often leading to misdiagnosis and overtreatment. IPEH involving the uterine myometrium is a novel finding. We describe an 83-year-old postmenopausal woman presenting with a 6-day history of spontaneous vaginal bleeding.

pmc-13273771.title: Vitamin D and antimicrobial peptides in skin health and disease: Mechanisms and therapeutic potential
pmc-13273771.creator: Hanlin Gao, Jianwei Zhu, Zhi Chen, Gang Wang
pmc-13273771.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). As the body's frontline barrier against the external environment, the skin maintains homeostasis through a complex network of innate defense factors, among which antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) play pivotal roles in pathogen defense, inflammation regulation, and tissue repair. Apart from its classical role in bone metabolism, Vitamin D has been shown, mainly in experimental and translational studies, to modulate the expression and processing of selected AMPs through VDR-dependent and non-classical pathways.

pmc-13357859.title: Differences in associations between attention‐deficit hyperactivity disorder symptoms and physical activity across childhood and adolescence and among males and females in a representative UK birth cohort
pmc-13357859.creator: Amandine Sénéquier, Stamatina Iliodromiti, Jessica Agnew‐Blais
pmc-13357859.description: BackgroundChildren and adolescents with attention‐deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) exhibit higher physical activity (PA) levels than peers without ADHD. It remains unclear how this association evolves across developmental stages and differs between sexes. This study explores associations between ADHD symptoms and PA levels in childhood and adolescence, focusing on sex differences.

pmc-13360501.title: Christensenella massiliensis reduces kynurenine levels and alleviates obesity and related metabolic disorders in model mice
pmc-13360501.creator: MengXuan Du, Wenzhao Wang, Min-Zhi Jiang, Xin-Wei Sun, Lei Sun, Chang Liu, Shuang-Jiang Liu
pmc-13360501.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Next-generation probiotics derived from gut commensals show promise for metabolic disease intervention, yet effective anti-obesity strains remain limited. Here, we demonstrate that oral administration of Christensenella massiliensis markedly alleviates obesity and metabolic dysfunction in high-fat diet-induced obese mice. Treatment reduced food intake, improved glucose tolerance and insulin sensitivity, lowered blood glucose and lipid levels, and attenuated hepatic steatosis and adipose accumulation.

pmc-13721652.title: Radiation therapy in breast cancer patients in south west Nigeria: an evaluation of protocols in a specialist cancer centre
pmc-13721652.creator: Adewumi Alabi, Francis Boateng, William Swanson, Anthonia Sowunmi, Bolanle Adegboyega, Victoria Ainsworth, Abdulrazzaq Lawal, Bukola Oshikanlu, Ademola Oyekan, Inioluwa Ariyo, Onyinye Balogun, Emadelden Fouad, Fallon Chipidza, Wilfred Ngwa
pmc-13721652.description: BackgroundBreast cancer is the most common malignancy among women worldwide and carries disproportionate mortality in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) where late presentation and constrained radiotherapy capacity are common. We report the initial institutional dosimetric experience of postoperative breast irradiation delivered with intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) at a new comprehensive cancer centre in South-West Nigeria.
